post.description:
Start the checkout Saga.

1. Check idempotency key.
2. Fetch the user's cart.
3. Reserve stock in Inventory.
4. Persist order as ``PENDIENTE_DE_PAGO``.

The ``Idempotency-Key`` header is **required** — a UUID v4 generated
by the mobile app when the user taps "Pay".

get.summary: List orders for the current user
get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of orders belonging to the user.

post.description:
Callback from the Payments service to resolve the Saga.

This is an **internal endpoint** — called by the Payments service
over the K8s internal network.  No ``X-User-Id`` header is required.

- ``SUCCESS`` → ``CONFIRMADA`` + commit stock + clear cart.
- ``FAILED``  → ``PAGO_RECHAZADO`` + rollback stock (compensation).

post.description:
Callback from the Payments service to update item status after a refund.

This is an **internal endpoint** — called by the Payments service
over the K8s internal network.  No ``X-User-Id`` header is required.

- ``approved`` → Item status updated to ``REEMBOLSO_PROCESADO``.
- ``rejected`` or ``canceled`` → Item status remains unchanged, but logged.

get.summary: Exportar una sección de métricas a CSV
get.description:
Descarga inmediata de un CSV según `metric_type`. No genera un único archivo con todo el panel: el backoffice debe invocar este endpoint una vez por tipo (`orders`, `products`, `categories`) usando el mismo rango de fechas.

**Contenido por tipo:**
- `orders`: serie temporal diaria (fecha, cantidad de órdenes, monto). No incluye totales del período ni distribución por estado.
- `products`: ranking de productos (hasta 1000 filas).
- `categories`: ventas agrupadas por categoría.

Las métricas de usuarios registrados pertenecen al servicio de usuarios.

OrderItemLogisticStatus.title: OrderItemLogisticStatus
OrderItemLogisticStatus.description:
Logistic state of an individual order item, per vendor.

Separate from the order's financial status (OrderStatus).
Each item can be in a different logistic state independently.

aggregated_status.title: Aggregated Status
aggregated_status.description:
Compute aggregated logistic status from items.

Returns None if no items exist. Otherwise returns the most restrictive state:
- If any item is EN_PREPARACION → EN_PREPARACION
- If any item is ENVIADO → ENVIADA
- If all are ENTREGADA → ENTREGADA
- If all are CANCELADA → CANCELADA

OrderStatus.title: OrderStatus
OrderStatus.description:
All valid order states.  Uses ``StrEnum`` so the value is the
string itself, which is what gets stored in the database column.

These represent the financial state of the order, not the logistics state.
